html:
Mohamed Ibrahim Warsame, known as Hadrawi, was a Somali poet and songwriter, often called the greatest Somali poet of the 20th century.

Somalis have long been called a nation of poets: oral verse carried news, settled disputes and spread political ideas among the herders. Hadrawi wrote love songs and political poems for radio and theatre in Mogadishu. His criticism of Siad Barre's rule got him jailed without trial from 1973 to 1978.

He later joined the rebels and, after the civil war, walked across the country on a peace march in 2003. His poems on war, love and faith are known by heart across the Somali world. He died in Hargeisa in 2022.
sum: Mohamed Ibrahim Warsame, known as Hadrawi, was a Somali poet and songwriter, often called the greatest Somali poet of the 20th century.
